question: On the morning of the trip, 9 classes arrived at the park gates with 95 students in each class. By late morning 63 parents and teachers had joined the group as well. At the ticket office every person in the group needed 3 separate entry tickets, one for each attraction. Each of those tickets cost 7 dollars. In the afternoon the park applied a group discount that took 1440 dollars off the bill, and in the evening a booking fee of 59 dollars was added. What was the final cost of the trip in dollars?

A youth club's trip fund started the term with 30 dollars. A cake sale added 68 dollars, and 59 dollars were spent on paint. The club has 9 branches, and every branch raised exactly the same amount as this one, with all of it going into one shared fund. The shared fund then paid 210 dollars for a coach. A raffle brought in 51 dollars and a car wash another 20 dollars, and the treasurer records everything in dollars rather than in cents. Half of the club's members joined only this year. How many dollars are in the shared fund now?

A smallholder kept 47 hens and bought 27 more at the spring auction. She sold 65 hens to a neighbouring farm, and a fox took 3 more. Each hen she has left lays 4 eggs a week. She also buys 32 eggs a week from a friend to make up her order. Every egg is sold for 6 pence, because her stall lists prices in pence rather than in pounds. How many pence does she take each week?

A cannery received 130 crates of peaches in the morning and exactly the same number again in the afternoon, so 2 shipments arrived that day. All of those crates were shared equally among the company's 5 shops. The shop on Mill Street then took in 50 crates from a cancelled order and 72 crates from the old store room. Its records are kept in single crates rather than in pallets. Over the weekend the Mill Street shop sold 159 crates. How many crates does the Mill Street shop have left?

Jonas had 58 model bricks, and his cousin Priya gave him 20 more, which was fewer than he already had. He lost 6 of them down a drain and glued 70 of them into a bridge that he will never take apart. Each brick he still has loose can be split into 3 smaller blocks. He then found 20 more loose blocks in an old box under his bed. Every block has 2 studs on its top face. The set was made 24 years ago. How many studs are on his loose blocks?

Rafael filled 8 tubs with 206 screws in each tub and tipped them all into one crate. He added 60 loose screws from his workbench, and his apprentice Nina added 12 more, far fewer than Rafael had contributed. Every pallet at the depot carries 4 crates packed exactly like that one, plus 54 spare screws tucked under the wrapping. On Tuesday 7 identical pallets were loaded for the building site. The depot's forklift can lift 900 kilograms. How many screws went to the building site?

A school print room produced 172 booklets on each of the 7 days before term started. The whole pile was then split into 2 equal shares, one for each campus, and the north campus carried its share to its own store room. During the first week the north campus handed out 251 booklets to students. A leaking pipe ruined 100 more, and 5 were damaged in the post. Later 16 booklets came back from a cancelled class. How many booklets are in the north campus store room?

A bike shop opened the month with 217 inner tubes in stock. It fitted 143 of them to customers' bikes during the sale. A cycling club then bought 71 tubes for its tour. The shop threw away 1 more tube that was found punctured inside the box. The shop sits 4 doors down from the station. A delivery van later brought 73 new tubes. How many inner tubes does the shop have now?

A school pond had 26 lily pads floating on it at the start of spring. A cold night killed 9 of them. The gardener added 78 new pads in April and another 36 in May. Slugs destroyed 4 pads in June. Each lily pad still on the pond carries 2 flowers. How many flowers are on the pond?

A pottery had 233 boxes of mugs in its store room and packed 66 more on Monday. A hotel order took 276 boxes away. During the move 16 boxes were crushed and thrown out. The pottery has 3 kilns in the back yard. Every box still in the store holds 6 mugs, and all of those mugs were then shared equally among 6 village shops. The corner shop received one of those shares. How many mugs did the corner shop receive?

On Saturday morning a farm shop had 132 punnets of strawberries in the chiller, and the afternoon delivery brought exactly the same number again, so 2 identical loads sat side by side. During the afternoon 81 punnets were sold at the counter. In the early evening a wedding caterer collected 175 punnets. The shop's car park holds 18 cars. Late that evening a grower dropped off 42 punnets that a market had refused. How many punnets were in the chiller at the end of the day?

Tomas keeps his savings in a jar and counts them in dollars rather than in cents. He started the month with 56 dollars and spent 13 dollars on a book. He then earned 44 dollars helping at his uncle's market stall. A new pair of running shoes cost him 57 dollars. His bus pass costs 9 dollars a month, but the school pays for that. He later gave 22 dollars to his sister. How many dollars are in the jar now?

Early on Monday morning a hostel had 134 clean sheets, and 10 of them were found torn and thrown out. Before lunch the laundry returned 68 more sheets. In the afternoon all the sheets were shared equally among the hostel's 3 floors. On the top floor 28 sheets were used by guests that evening. Every sheet still on the top floor can be folded into 3 pillow covers, and each cover takes 4 clips to hang on the line. How many clips does the top floor need?

A vineyard filled 7 barrels with 205 litres of juice in each barrel. During fermentation 653 litres were lost, and a restaurant bought 376 litres straight from the barrels. The juice that remained was bottled, and every litre filled exactly 2 bottles. The cellar door has been open since 1974. A worker found 3 bottles from that batch on a back shelf and added them to the stack. A merchant then bought 400 bottles. How many bottles are left in the cellar?

The cinema had 20 loyalty cards left in the drawer and printed 46 more for the new season. Every one of those cards carries 7 stamps. Each stamp is worth 9 reward points when it is handed in. The manager added 58 extra points to the scheme as an opening bonus. At the kiosk every reward point can be swapped for 2 tokens. How many tokens are all of those points worth?

Early in the morning a pottery studio had 95 kilograms of clay and used 41 kilograms on a large order. The rest was divided equally between the studio's 2 workrooms, and the east workroom took its share. In the afternoon the east workroom shaped 8 tiles from every kilogram it had. Those tiles were then shared equally among the 3 evening classes. One class packed its tiles equally into 4 boxes. The studio weighs its clay in kilograms rather than in grams. How many tiles went into one of those boxes?

On Monday morning Leah had 47 empty jars ready for the honey harvest. By midday her neighbour Tomas had brought her 76 more jars, more than Leah had gathered herself. In the afternoon every jar was filled with 6 ounces of honey and put in the store. That evening a bulk order took 113 ounces out of the store. Late at night another beekeeper delivered 67 ounces to the same store. How many ounces of honey are in the store?

On Saturday morning a scout troop had 78 tent pegs in the kit box. They lost 21 pegs on the walk up the hill and bent 14 more while pitching camp. In the afternoon the quartermaster found that each usable peg had 9 spare washers threaded onto it. That evening 8 of those washers rolled into the stream and were lost. A leader then handed over 71 washers from his own kit. How many washers did the troop have?

Miriam counted 228 bricks in the yard, and her cousin Ade added 37 bricks, a smaller pile than Miriam's. A skip delivery brought 30 more bricks, and a demolition down the road provided another 26. Each brick in the yard weighs 7 pounds, and half of them are already stacked on a pallet. What is the total weight, in pounds, of the bricks in the yard?

On Monday morning a furniture factory ran 3 assembly lines, and each line produced 27 chairs for one batch. In the afternoon 67 chairs came back from a cancelled order and joined that same batch. Fitting each chair in the batch takes 7 screws. The contract covers 3 identical hotels, and every hotel receives a batch of exactly that size. That evening the storeman added 32 spare screws to the shipment. The factory van holds 40 boxes. How many screws are in the shipment?

In the morning Elias filled 9 crates with 30 apples in each crate. The whole pile was divided into 2 equal shares, and one share went to the juice press while the other stayed in the barn. In the afternoon every apple left in the barn was cut into 4 slices for the drying racks. His neighbour Farida added 33 slices of her own, far fewer than Elias had prepared. In the evening the family ate 37 slices straight off the racks. The farm weighs its fruit in kilograms rather than in grams. How many apple slices were left on the drying racks?

The bus depot logs its driving in minutes rather than in hours. Each day one bus covers 3 routes that take 166 minutes apiece, and 26 minutes of depot shunting are added on top of that. The same pattern was repeated on each of the 9 days of the roadworks. All of those minutes were then shared equally between the 2 drivers who cover that bus. How many minutes did one driver spend on the bus?

A school kitchen had 33 crates of milk and ordered 20 more for the new term. 6 of the crates arrived leaking and were sent straight back. The kitchen has 4 large fridges along the wall. Every crate the kitchen kept holds 6 cartons, and a cook found 38 loose cartons in the store cupboard and added them in. Each carton pours 2 cups, because the kitchen measures its milk in cups rather than in litres. How many cups of milk does the kitchen have?

Hassan filled 201 sandbags on the first day and exactly the same number on the second, so 2 days of his work went into the pile. His neighbour Lucia added 79 sandbags and a council lorry brought 78 more, so Lucia's contribution was far smaller than Hassan's. Each sandbag in the pile holds 3 buckets of sand. Every bucket of sand weighs 4 kilograms. The flood defence used up 1647 kilograms of that sand. How many kilograms of sand are left?

A community pantry started the month with 140 tins of soup. A supermarket donated 69 tins, and a church collection brought in 74 more. Every tin holds 5 servings, and the pantry counts its stock in servings rather than in tins. Over the winter 1369 servings were handed out, and half of those went to families with young children. How many servings are left in the pantry?
